widget.doc: A labeled text field that keeps what is typed in your variable: InputField "Email" "you@example.com" =email; obscure:true masks a password, lines:6 makes a multi-line box, icon:"search_rounded" a search field, error:=cond?"message":"" shows a red message under it, success a green one.

props.doc: The name of your text variable: the field shows it and writes it as the user types.
The label over the field (empty: none).
Shown while the field is empty.
More than 1 makes it a multi-line box about that many lines tall (a message body).
A Material icon inside the field, e.g. search_rounded (empty: none).
A message under the field, in red with a red border (empty: no error).
A green confirmation under the field, e.g. "SAVE10 applied" (empty: none).
Mask the characters of a one-line password field.
